title: Hidden Fees That Drain Your Wallet

scenes.text: Did you notice $12 hidden fees on a $200 bill?

scenes.label: OVERDRAFT CHARGES
scenes.text: Overdraft fees can cost up to $35 each time you dip below zero.

scenes.label: PAYMENT PROCESSOR SURCHARGES
scenes.text: Many merchants add a 2‑3 % surcharge for card payments.

scenes.label: ANNUAL ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE
scenes.text: Some checking accounts charge $12‑$15 monthly just to stay open.
Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: Uncover the three most common hidden fees that silently eat your money. Learn how to spot and avoid them today. Follow for more money‑saving tips.
